sources.title: bert-large-NER: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview bert-large-NER is a fine-tuned BERT model built by dslim for Named Entity Recognition that identifies four entity types: person (PER), organization (ORG), location (LOC), and miscellaneous (MISC). The model uses a bert-large-cased architecture fine-tuned on the English CoNLL-2003 dataset, achieving test performance of 91.7 F1, 91.2 precision, and 92.3 recall. You load and run it via ...
